title: stdout envelope of every exec.py command
description: Exactly one JSON object on stdout per invocation, one line (compact) unless --pretty. ok is true iff the exit code is 0. data is null when the command failed before producing anything. errors lists every E_* problem (exit 1-4); warnings lists W_* notes that did not change the exit code.

command.description: The subcommand path as typed, space separated: 'plan instantiate', 'wave emit', 'status'.
